detection_pack.sigma:
title: APEX - consciousness-explorer / sublinear-time-solver MCP export_st — Path Traversal
id: apex-pt-567f9427
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects path traversal exploitation for CVE-2026-55609. Covers encoded and double-encoded traversal sequences used to read sensitive files outside the web root.
  Generated by CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v184.0
references:
    - https://intel.cyberdudebivash.com
    - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-55609
author: CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX
date: 2026/10/20
tags:
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.t1190
    - attack.t1083
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  path_traversal_basic:
    cs-uri-query|contains:
      - '../'
      - '..%2F'
      - '..%5C'
      - '..\'
      - '/%2e%2e/'
      - '/%2e%2e%2f'
  sensitive_file_access:
    cs-uri-stem|contains:
      - '/etc/passwd'
      - '/etc/shadow'
      - '/etc/hosts'
      - '/.ssh/id_rsa'
      - '/proc/self/environ'
      - '/windows/win.ini'
      - '/windows/system32/drivers/etc/hosts'
      - 'web.config'
      - '.env'
      - 'application.properties'
      - 'wp-config.php'
  double_encoded_traversal:
    cs-uri-query|contains:
      - '%252e%252e%252f'
      - '%252e%252e/'
      - '..%252f'
      - '%c0%ae%c0%ae/'
  condition: path_traversal_basic or sensitive_file_access or double_encoded_traversal
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate files with dots in their names accessed via URL parameters
  - Security scanner traversal testing
level: high

detection_pack.yara:
rule APEX_CVE_2026_55609__PATH_TRAVERSAL {
    meta:
        description   = "APEX detection: consciousness-explorer / sublinear-time-solver MCP export_state has an"
        cve           = "CVE-2026-55609"
        vuln_class    = "PATH_TRAVERSAL"
        author        = "CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v184.0"
        date          = "2026-10-20"
        reference     = "https://intel.cyberdudebivash.com"
        severity      = "high"
        mitre_attack  = "T1190"
    strings:
        $pt_seq1 = "../" ascii wide nocase  // Path traversal
        $pt_seq2 = "../etc/passwd" ascii wide nocase  // Sensitive file access
        $pt_dotdot = "..%2F" ascii wide nocase  // URL-encoded traversal
        $pt_win = "..\windows\win.ini" ascii wide nocase  // Windows traversal
    condition:
        2 of them
}
